metadata.defaultTitle: Kenet: a personal journal built on people, places and time
metadata.defaultDescription: Kenet is a personal journal for iPhone, iPad and Mac that needs no account and keeps your data in plain Markdown files. It links the short entries you write during the day to people, places and time, and asks when a name is ambiguous. Tasks and goals live here too. The vault matches Obsidian's format and stays where you choose.
